30 October 2026. C's completed restricted operation. Ordinary product
tomography, Bell/StateHSP learning and symplectic synthesis are credited;
this is not a new generic Clifford-learning or noise-threshold claim.
The actual finite execution is computational, not a laboratory experiment.

## 1. Source and consequence

A fixed memoryless CPTP source N maps q logical qubits to n physical
qubits. Training access consists ONLY of fresh Bell-input programs
J=(id_R tensor N)(Phi_(2^q)), plus known controls/measurements. The
unknown late payload is already encoded by the same N, may be entangled
with an inaccessible reference, and is not available or retried during
calibration. No unknown U, junk description, environment, adjoint,
controlled N or classical model is supplied to the receiver.

For efficient candidate discovery, the STRUCTURAL promise is an ideal
mixed Clifford encoding N0(rho)=U(rho tensor sigma)U*, with arbitrary
sigma, for which the physical images of the2q logical X/Z generators
lie in supplied patches S_a of size at most w. For example, a warranted
depth-d geometric Clifford circuit and known logical input positions
give its native causal neighborhoods. This is not an inference from a
preview or from finitely many records. Unknown support of weight w would
instead require a choose(n,w) search; this is not silently replaced by
a supplied small neighborhood.

The ACTUAL N may contain coherent or dissipative calibration error. The
quality theorem below does not assume N0 exists: it uses fresh measured
correlations of actual N. The structural/noise promise only ensures a
high-quality frame can be found at the declared cost. Bell preparation,
measurement calibration, independent shots and known-gate accuracy are
separate operational requirements, not acquired hardware facts.

Output: a finite CLASSICAL list of known Clifford gates and an output
wire set. Apply that circuit to each late payload, retain q wires, discard
the rest. All source calls precede payload arrival. There is no protected
quantum program, program refresh, generic Schur/RDS factory or online
source-call latency in the returned decoder.

# Robust dense Clifford recovery from a low mixed-nullity source

This constructs the missing robust acquisition step using actual copies of a fixed forward source, not a supplied stabilizer list, conditional state oracle, or controlled encoding inverse. Bell sampling and symplectic compilation are ordinary primitives. The distinctive link is a positive coset-projection inequality which handles GLOBAL coherent source errors without inferring a convex clean component.

The initial fixed-reference-label construction is A's. Root independently reconstructed that link and supplied the adaptive hyperplane refinement in Section 5, removing its exponential dependence on the number of logical qubits. C supplies the reusable public signed-Pauli compiler. Their source files and execution scope are kept separate from this derivation.

## 1. Source, promise and native operations

Let q logical qubits be encoded in n physical qubits. Write k=2^q and m=n+q. The ideal source has the form

`N0(w)=U0[w tensor |0><0|^(n-q-t) tensor sigma_t]U0^*`,       (1)

where U0 is an UNKNOWN physical Clifford and sigma_t is an arbitrary UNKNOWN mixed t-qubit state. The pure ancillas may themselves be in an unknown stabilizer frame, which can be absorbed into U0. The t-qubit state may have arbitrary rank, magic, degeneracy and conditioning. There is no local-support/weight promise on U0 or its logical Pauli images.

The actual source N is fixed memoryless CPTP, with normalized channel Choi states rho and rho0. The structural completeness hypothesis is

`Dtr(rho,rho0)=(1/2)||rho-rho0||_1<=eta`.                    (2)

It is a GLOBAL trace-distance hypothesis, not constant error per site, gate or output qubit. It is not inferred from an unverified device fidelity. In particular a nearby unitary channel need not have any nonzero convex identity component; that stronger and generally false inference is NOT used.

Native calibration consists of independently preparing q known Bell pairs, sending one half through N, and retaining its reference. Four such Choi programmes allow two transversal Bell measurements; XOR their phase-free Pauli labels to obtain a Bell DIFFERENCE label in F2^(2m). There are four forward calls per candidate.
